verdict.rationale: Repository rulesets can require pull requests, reviews, passing checks and CODEOWNERS approval, with an Evaluate mode for warnings-only trials. Buildkite builds and GitHub Actions results appear as checks on pull requests, so CI-driven quality gates can block merges. Missing for 10: a documented status/checks API for posting arbitrary custom checks beyond Buildkite/GitHub Actions, detail on selecting specific required checks or org-wide compliance policies, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
